info.name: Permit.io Access Requests (EAP) Access Requests (EAP) Audit Elements Data API

params.name: proj_id
params.description: Either the unique id of the project, or the URL-friendly key of the project (i.e: the "slug").

params.name: env_id
params.description: Either the unique id of the environment, or the URL-friendly key of the environment (i.e: the "slug").

params.name: elements_config_id
params.description: Either the unique id of the elements_config, or the URL-friendly key of the elements_config (i.e: the "slug").

params.name: search
params.description: Text search for the email field

params.name: page
params.description: Page number of the results to fetch, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: The number of results per page (max 100).

items.docs: Lists audit logs for for specific elements config (tenant scope)
